===Armor===
By turning in 20 [[Blue Dragon Scale]]s to [[Armec Orem]] (Master Blue Scalesmith of the Zakya cult), he will craft you one of these:
* {{Item|Blue Dragonhide Armor}}
* {{Item|Blue Dragonplate Armor}}
* {{Item|Blue Dragonscale Armor}}
* {{Item|Blue Dragonscale Docent}}
* {{Item|Blue Dragonscale Robe}}

See also: [[Dragonscale Armor]] (comparison of all dragonscale options)
